items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah, I worked with both of them. I worked with Leon when he owned the Avalon Club out here in Metry.

ctx.x: Do you remember who any of the fellas with the Pansy Lane's band were?
I remember that, uh, Leon Mello's brother played drum.

items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: We used to call him Foots. Bigfoot. We used to call him Foots Mello. And Harry Shields played clarinet. Pansy played trumpet. And, uh, who played piano now? I don't remember who played piano with us.
